settings.question: What is a sit-stand desk?
settings.answer: A sit-stand desk is a height-adjustable desk that raises and lowers so the same person can work seated or standing through the day. Commercial models usually use an electric dual-motor base with a programmable height range. They are also called height-adjustable desks, electric standing desks, or sit-to-stand workstations.

settings.question: Do you deliver and install sit-stand desks across Ontario?
settings.answer: Yes. Our own crew delivers, assembles, levels, and places every desk and clears the packaging, across Ontario. The space is work-ready when they leave — you are not assembling a flat-pack or booking a separate installer.

settings.question: Can I order just one, or do I need a bulk quantity?
settings.answer: Both. We supply single height-adjustable desks for a private office and full floors of sit-stand workstations for institutional fit-outs. Tell us the quantity and timeline and we will quote it either way.

settings.question: Are any of your sit-stand desks Canadian-made?
settings.answer: Yes. We carry Canadian-made height-adjustable lines alongside imported options, so buyers with domestic-content or lead-time priorities have a real choice. Ask us to flag the Canadian-made lines on your quote.

settings.question: Can Ontario institutions buy without an open tender?
settings.answer: Eligible Ontario broader-public-sector buyers — school boards, hospitals, and municipalities — can purchase from us without an open tender under our OECM Supplier Partner agreement, held by our parent legal entity, Brant Basics. Call us and we will confirm your eligibility.

settings.question: What is the difference between a sit-stand desk and a desktop riser?
settings.answer: A sit-stand desk replaces the whole desk with a height-adjustable frame and top. A desktop riser sits on your existing desk and lifts just the working surface. Risers are a lower-cost way to convert desks you already own; a full sit-stand desk gives a cleaner result and a wider height range.
